messages:
Ashley: heads-up: Acme POC hitting 429s during a 40s parallel run. logs (redacted): https://acme-demo.logs/recent

Samir: can you paste one example error + headers? need to know if this is per-route rpm or token throttling.

acme-agent: sample -> "{\"error\":\"Too many requests\",\"status\":429}"
headers: x-ratelimit-limit: 60, x-ratelimit-remaining: 0, x-ratelimit-reset: 11

Miguel (oncall): default /v1/generate = 60 rpm short window. How many parallel workers and avg tokens/request?

Ashley: 10 workers, ~1 req/s each for ~70s. avg payload ~1200 tokens. Sales worried about token budget for the deal.

Jia: quick math: 10 r/s -> 600 rpm, so per-route 60 rpm will trigger first. token-rate: 10 r/s * 1200 tokens = 12k tokens/s -> 720k tokens/min which would exceed typical token-rate caps. Both are relevant.

Samir: propose temp bump for trial: /v1/generate -> rpm=180, token-rate=40000 tokens/min, 7-day TTL. Anyone object?

Miguel: OK if gated and audited. Also add burst to absorb startup. Suggest burst_capacity=400 over 30s. Add monitoring alert for >2% 1-min error rate.

Samir: applying CLI changes:
`redwoodctl quotas update --org acme-corp --route /v1/generate --rpm 180 --token-rate 40000 --ttl 7d --note "trial bump for Acme POC"`
(Change q-110022)

rate-limiter-bot: Policy apply succeeded for org "acme-corp" (change q-110022). per-route rpm=180, token_rate=40000 tokens/min.

Samir: now adding burst patch:
`redwoodctl quotas patch --org acme-corp --route /v1/generate --burst_capacity 400 --burst_window 30 --note "startup smoothing"`
(Change q-110023)

rate-limiter-bot: Burst policy updated (q-110023). burst_capacity=400, burst_window=30s.

Ashley: sent update to customer; they re-ran. initial startup showed one 429 then mostly 200s: 
[2026-10-01T10:12:03Z] POST /v1/generate 429 x-ratelimit-remaining:0
[2026-10-01T10:12:05Z] POST /v1/generate 200 1190 tokens

Miguel: that single 429 is likely propagation/window-edge. We'll monitor. Jia please file a small INF to add a sales template for quota bumps.

Jia: filing INF-5021: "sales quota bump template" with recommended values and TTL.

Samir: audit: q-110022, q-110023 recorded; auto-expire per TTL.

Ashley: marking as mitigated for now. I'll ask sales if they want extension. Thanks all :heart:
